blahblahblah.marked: Markdown parser for the fundraiser bios in src/data/fundraiser/bios/. Reason: StorePanel had three hand-rolled regex passes to turn <a href> markup, <url> brackets and bare pasted URLs into links, and a bare URL silently rendered as dead text. One parser replaces all three, so bios are now plain markdown and inline formatting works for free. No install scripts.
